screens.text: For the end, a Psalm of David, concerning her that inherits. Listen to my words, O Lord, attend to my cry. Attend to the voice of my supplication, my King, and my God: for to you, O Lord, will I pray.
In the morning you shall hear my voice: in the morning will I wait upon you, and will look up. For you are not a god that desires iniquity; neither shall the worker of wickedness dwell with you.
Neither shall the transgressors continue in your sight: you hate, O Lord, all them that work iniquity. You will destroy all that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man.

But I will enter into your house in the multitude of your mercy: I will worship in your fear toward your holy temple. Lead me, O Lord, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make my way plain before your face.
